scope: Declared expected byte availability ONLY; no mathematical validation or replay.
streamed_input_counter_scope: Hash/member reads only; excludes parser and ZIP central-directory rereads.
caveat: Basename+SHA proves only the existence of matching member content; identical empty logs do not recover a particular execution. Named embedded directory trees are included; nested ZIP interiors are not. Known corrupt standalone threshold31 ZIP is deliberately not an input.
